description: This file defines a PHP class 'PregMatchTypeSpecifyingExtension' that implements static method type specification and type specifier awareness for PHPStan, specifically for regex match functions in the Composer Pcre namespace.

classes.name: PregMatchTypeSpecifyingExtension
classes.description: A class that extends PHPStan's static method type specifying capabilities to handle regex match functions in the Composer Pcre namespace.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regex shape matcher dependency.

methods.name: setTypeSpecifier
methods.description: Sets the type specifier instance used for type analysis.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class name this extension supports, which is 'Preg'.

methods.name: isStaticMethodSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given static method call is supported by this extension based on method name and context.

methods.name: specifyTypes
methods.description: Determines and specifies the types for regex match methods based on call arguments and context.
